the idea from that first night ↓

One project. Many layers.

InterXview-AI · Team Project

An AI-powered mock interview platform designed to help candidates prepare for real interviews through a structured interview experience.

The Problem

Preparing for technical interviews can be difficult without realistic practice and structured feedback.

The Solution

A guided mock interview experience where candidates practice questions based on their selected role and interview level.

My Contribution — Team Lead & Developer

I helped organize the workflow and divide responsibilities across the team. I also contributed to the frontend interface, interview flow, AI-related logic, backend development, database work, and the initial UI direction in Figma.

React / JavaScript / Tailwind CSS · Node.js / Express · PostgreSQL
